# `oaap app logs`

show an instance's container log (RFC-0038).

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app logs [--tail TAIL] [--service SERVICE]
                     [--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT]
                     name
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | -- |
| `--tail TAIL` | how many lines per service (default 200, at most 1000) |
| `--service SERVICE` | only this service of a multi-container app |
| `--tenant INSTANCE_TENANT` | tenant label: read the instance as a NAME inside this tenant (also: <tenant>/<name>) |
